title: Rat Boots
description: Adds rat boots (what a surprise) that give certain perks when worn
body:
Have you ever wanted to become small, fast, and be able to eat a lot of random stuff? If yes then this datapack is just for you!
It adds craftable rat boots. That's it. Hope you like it.

**Recipe**

![Crafting recipe for rat boots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf42e6bba26f009decfd9e96a2ec5d6928586feb.png)

Diamonds can be anything that is able to make armor (iron, gold etc.). To make netherite boots you just have to upgrade diamond ones.

While wearing these boots you get smaller, small enough to squeeze into 1 block spaces when crouching, a little bit faster, you can jump from 6 blocks before taking damage opposing to 4 normally, you also can be underwater for a tini tiny bit longer, and the best one... you can eat more things!!!
Also you get "[Rat]" next to your name to indicate you are a rat, and have only 8 hearts to balance it ou- i mean, because rats are smaller so they should have less hp right...?

Here is  a list of all the things you can eat, but if you're too lazy to look at it, every item you can eat will have "consumable" written in their lore while you are a rat (note thta you have to hold an item in order to make it edible - just having it in inventory won't change it).
- wheat
- wheat seeds
- beetroot seeds
- melon seeds
- pumpkin seeds
- torchflower seeds
- crimson  ~~seeds~~ roots
- hanging roots
- moan... I meant mangrove roots
- warped roots
- glow lichen
- spider eyes (without consequences = wc)
- fermented spider eyes
- rotten flesh (wc)
- bones
- bone **meal** (now literally)
- pufferfish (wc)
- raw gold
- raw iron
- gold ingot
- iron ingot
- coal
- charcoal
- sticks
- eggs
- echo shard (you can't stop me)
- bowls
- magma cream
- slime BALS
- honeycomb

If you throw your "food" to someone that is not a rat, this person won't be able to eat it.

If you have any suggestions or complaints please DM me on my dc - janolo7250

You can use my datapack in videos or anything like that if you include a link to this modritnh project. You cannot repost or promote it as your work.
